content: Pamabrom is a diuretic agent that is included in various over-the-counter medications. The active diuretic component in pamabrom is 8-bromotheophylline. This compound is also available in combination with acetaminophen (paracetamol) for the purpose of alleviating menstrual symptoms. In this combination, acetaminophen serves to reduce menstrual pain, while pamabrom helps to alleviate bloating associated with menstruation. Pamabrom is marketed under several brand names, including Midol Maximum Strength Teen Formula, Women's Tylenol Menstrual Relief, and Pamprin Maximum Strength Menstrual Pain Relief Multi-Symptom. These products, as well as generic drugstore versions, generally contain similar dosages of the active ingredients. The combination of acetaminophen and pamabrom is also promoted as a pain reliever for conditions such as backache, headache, and muscle ache. Additionally, it can function as a mild muscle relaxant.
